findings.body:
chunk 3/3:

The replacement `.forge/hooks.sh` has CRLF line endings. On Unix, the carriage return becomes part of shell keywords such as `do`, so sourcing the file fails with a syntax error. The normal commit hook path cannot run until this script uses LF line endings.
findings.title: Git hooks fail when sourcing the generated shell script
